records.title: How to Run a Custom Tracking Category Report in Xero | Project and Donor Reporting (South Africa)
records.description: Learn how to run a custom report for a Tracking Category in Xero so your South African NPO, NGO, or non-profit organisation can report by project, donor, funder, programme, or cost centre. This tutorial shows you how to filter a report by tracking category, customise the layout, and save the report so you can reuse it for monthly reporting and funder reporting. Tracking Category reporting is one of the best ways to produce clean project and donor reports in Xero without duplicating accounts in your Chart of Accounts. In this video you’ll see: How to select a Tracking Category in Xero reporting How to run a report filtered by project, donor, or programme How to customise a report layout for clearer tracking category reporting How to compare periods and drill down into figures How to save and reuse the custom tracking category report Tips for accurate tracking category reporting for NPOs Common searches this video helps with: xero tracking category report custom report xero tracking category run report by tracking category xero xero project report custom xero donor reporting xero xero funder reporting xero npo reporting south africa This is part of Turning Point Chartered Accountants’ Xero tutorial series for South African NPOs, NGOs, and non-profit organisations.

records.title: Durban Documentary | SAFDA at 10 Years | A Decade Empowering South African Farmers | NGO Film
records.description: NGO documentary marking a decade of agricultural development across South Africa — produced by Audio Visual Lab, Durban's leading documentary and nonprofit video production company. SAFDA (South African Farmers Development Association) has spent 10 years empowering South African farmers through capacity building, economic development, and sector-wide transformation. This anniversary documentary captures the people, the milestones, and the impact behind one of South Africa's most dedicated agricultural NGOs. Filmed across South Africa, this documentary serves as a legacy record, donor reporting asset, and advocacy tool for SAFDA's continued mission in the agricultural sector. 📍 Filmed across South Africa 🏢 Client: SAFDA — South African Farmers Development Association 🎥 Video Type: NGO Anniversary Documentary | Agricultural Sector | Impact Film ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🎬 ABOUT AUDIO VISUAL LAB ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Audio Visual Lab is Durban's leading NGO and documentary video production company. records.title: Xero Session 6 Recording 1   How to find Tracking Categories in the new updated Xero View
records.description: Learn how to find Tracking Categories in the new updated Xero view and how to use them for project, donor, or programme reporting in your South African NPO, NGO, or non-profit organisation. This tutorial shows you where Tracking Categories are located in the updated Xero interface and what to check so your transactions can be tracked correctly. Tracking Categories are one of the most useful tools in Xero for NPOs that need to report by project, donor, funder, programme, or cost centre. When set up correctly, they help you produce clearer reports without changing your Chart of Accounts. In this video you’ll see: Where to find Tracking Categories in the new Xero view How Tracking Categories work for project and donor reporting What to check before you start using tracking on transactions Examples of how NPOs use tracking categories for funder reporting Common mistakes to avoid when setting up or selecting tracking Common searches this video helps with: xero tracking categories new view where to find tracking categories in xero xero tracking categories updated view xero tracking categories for nonprofits xero donor tracking xero project tracking xero npo reporting south africa This is part of Turning Point Chartered Accountants’ Xero tutorial series for South African NPOs, NGOs, and non-profit organisations.
